name: Luxe
thesis: The app is a quiet room: generous space, one beautiful object at a time, and confidence without noise.
bestFor: Fashion, beauty, hospitality, premium commerce, dining, and interiors.

variants.name: Atelier
variants.summary: An ivory atelier: serif title, one garment at a time, and generous space.
variants.signature: A full-bleed image with a small serif caption.
variants.treatment: Ivory surfaces, a serif display face, large imagery, and a slow, spacious rhythm.

variants.name: Concierge
variants.summary: A dark concierge: gold rules, curated cards, and quiet confidence.
variants.signature: A gold rule under the section label.

variants.name: Boutique
variants.summary: A soft boutique: pastel surfaces, rounded arches, and gentle motion.
variants.treatment: Soft pastel surfaces, an arched image treatment, serif display, and gentle motion.

signatureMoves: A full-bleed image with a small serif caption.
A gold rule under the section label.
A single object floating in generous space.

platform.ios: Use a large title sparingly; let the image lead. Keep the system back gesture. Use a transparent navigation bar that becomes opaque on scroll. Sheets for detail. Use a tab bar only for true peers.
platform.android: Edge-to-edge imagery with a scrim where text sits. Use a top app bar that fades in. Use a bottom sheet for detail. No FAB. Respect predictive back.

principles: Motion is slow but never blocking.
avoid: A wall of equal product cards.
A countdown timer on a premium product.

content.title: Quiet form
content.subtitle: A study in linen, stone, and light.

items.title: The wool throw
items.body: Woven in a small mill in Donegal

screens.home: One full-bleed image or one large product, a short serif title, and a single line of context. The collection list begins below the fold with generous spacing.
screens.detail: A product or place detail: large image, name, price, materials, one primary action, and a quiet secondary action. Show the real price and availability.
screens.compose: A booking or order flow: dates, guests, room or item, price, confirmation. Show the full price before payment.
screens.profile: A quiet account: orders, saved items, preferences. No gamification, no fake status tiers.

components.button: Rectangular or softly rounded, solid ink or accent, generous padding. Secondary actions are text with an underline.
components.list: Large image rows with a small serif title and one metadata line. Hairline separators, no cards.
components.input: Underline or soft filled field, generous height, quiet validation.
components.navigation: Transparent over imagery, tab bar for peers, sheets for detail.
